author: reek
body: The subject `build/plug-oracle-test.ps1` compiles twice: once to x86-64, once through a transpiler plug into that plug's language. Both are then RUN, and the two sets of answers must agree line for line.

author: reek
body: Both operands are parameters at every site. A literal dividend folds at compile time and would measure the constant folder, and a literal divisor takes the power-of-two strength reduction, which is a third path again.

author: reek
body: Negative operands are the whole point. A table of positive-only cases passes under every rounding rule ever invented and would prove nothing.
